candidates.evidence: Two strong lines at 127.8 and 306.0 cm-1 match the A1'(1) (~134) and A1'(2) (~307-308) out-of-plane modes of GaSe. The 306 cm-1 line fits very well. The 128 line is about 6 cm-1 below the usual value. The commonly seen E' (~213) and E (~250) modes are not resolved.
The same family, but its modes are expected near 188, 295 and 360 cm-1, so it does not match.
Their strongest modes (Bi2Te3 ~102/134, InSe ~115/178/200/227, In2Se3 ~110/175/205) do not reproduce the 128 + 306 pair.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was given in the metadata, so the identification rests on the spectrum alone.

peaks.assignment: GaSe A1'(1) (out-of-plane interlayer-like Ga-Ga/Se breathing mode)
peaks.source: Lorentzian fit; assignment from the GaSe Raman literature (A1'(1) ~134 cm-1), Allakhverdiev et al. and Terhell 1983. The ~6 cm-1 offset from the literature value is not explained.
Lorentzian fit; assignment from the GaSe literature (~307-308 cm-1).

peaks.assignment: Not a significant peak: a noise fluctuation (~1.8σ) near the expected GaSe E'(~213) region. The expected E'/E'' (~213) and E (~250) modes are not detected above the noise.
peaks.source: Noise estimate (std ~110 counts) from the 190-220 cm-1 window.

properties.name: Excitation / conditions
properties.value: 532 nm, 295 K, backscattering along the layer normal. Only the A1' modes are strongly seen, as expected for this geometry.
properties.source: Raman selection rules for backscattering from layered GaSe.

properties.name: Background
properties.value: The background rises smoothly from ~1100 counts at 60 cm-1 to ~3600 counts at ~900 cm-1. This looks like a photoluminescence or fluorescence tail from 532 nm excitation.

properties.name: Layer number
properties.value: Not determined. The A1' positions and widths cannot reliably separate thin from bulk GaSe here.

artifacts.type: cosmic-ray spike (single point, ~10900 counts over a ~2000-count baseline)

citations: Terhell, J.C.J.M., Prog. Cryst. Growth Charact. 7, 55 (1983), GaSe lattice and vibrational properties
Allakhverdiev et al., Solid State Commun. 149, 2009 (GaSe Raman)
Irwin, Clayman, Mead, Phys. Rev. B 19, 2099 (1979), GaSe Raman
limits: The assignment relies on two peaks. The match is good at 306 cm-1 but the 128 cm-1 line is about 6 cm-1 below the usual GaSe A1'(1) value (~134), which may reflect strain, a different polytype or a calibration offset.
The E' (~213) and E (~250) modes are not detected, so the polytype (ε, β, γ) cannot be determined.
Layer number, strain and doping cannot be determined from this single unpolarized spectrum.
This is a single spectrum with no angle resolution, so no polarization-pattern classification is possible.
The 327 cm-1 point is a one-pixel spike and was excluded as a cosmic ray. The 204 cm-1 feature is within the noise.
The substrate is unspecified, and no Si 520.7 cm-1 line is visible.
